== Overview ==

'''NATTraversalProtocol''' is used by clients when joining a multiplayer session. It provides a means for clients to establish peer-to-peer connections across NAT boundaries by initiating hole-punching attempts and reporting of NAT properties.

=== RequestProbeInitiation ===

Sent by the client to the server to begin NAT probing the local client at it's registered public address (see [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/SecureConnectionProtocol#Register|SecureConnectionProtocol#Register]]/[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/SecureConnectionProtocol#RegisterEx|SecureConnectionProtocol#RegisterEx]]).

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || urlTargetList || List of station addresses the local client wants the server to ask to probe it
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== InitiateProbe ===

Sent by the server to a client that is being requested for probing by another client.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || urlStationToProbe || The address of the station that would like the receiver to probe it
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== RequestProbeInitiationExt ===

Sent by the client to the server to begin NAT probing the local client at the specified address.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || urlTargetList || List of station addresses the local client wants the server to ask to probe it
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || urlStationToProbe || The address the local client would like receivers to probe
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== ReportNATTraversalResult ===

Sent by the client to the server to report the result of the NAT traversal attempt.

==== Request ====

<tabs items="NEX 2 and below,NEX 3.0+" storagekey="ReportNATTraversalResult">
	<tab name="NEX 2 and below">
		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| UInt32 || cid || The <code>RVCID</code> of the station the local client probed
		|-
		| Boolean || result || The result of the NAT traversal
		|}
	</tab>

	<tab name="NEX 3.0+">
		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| UInt32 || cid || The <code>RVCID</code> of the station the local client probed
		|-
		| Boolean || result || The result of the NAT traversal
		|-
		| UInt32 || rtt || The connections round-trip-time
		|}
	</tab>
</tabs>

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== ReportNATProperties ===

Sent by the client to the server to report the client's NAT properties.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || natmapping || Client's [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#NAT_Mapping|NAT mapping mode]]
|-
| UInt32 || natfiltering || Client's [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#NAT_Filtering|NAT filtering mode]]
|-
| UInt32 || rtt || The connections round-trip-time
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== GetRelaySignatureKey ===

Sent by the client to the server to request relay server information. Likely [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traversal_Using_Relays_around_NAT TURN], or equivalent.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Int32 || relayMode || Unknown
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] || currentUTCTime || The server's current UTC time
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || address || The address of the relay server
|-
| UInt16 || port || The port of the relay server
|-
| Int32 || relayAddressType || Unknown
|-
| UInt32 || gameServerID || The title's unique game server ID
|}

=== ReportNATTraversalResultDetail ===

Sent by the client to the server to report the result of the NAT traversal attempt with an extra detail field.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || cid || The <code>RVCID</code> of the station the local client probed
|-
| Boolean || result || The result of the NAT traversal
|-
| Int32 || detail || Unknown
|-
| UInt32 || rtt || The connections round-trip-time
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.
